evidence.claim: Local scaling metadata maps normalAttack/skill/burst to source talentKey combat1/combat2/combat3.
The local audit uses the same explicit combat1 -> normalAttack, combat2 -> skill, combat3 -> burst table.
Resolver talent metadata has semantic groups and display text but no UID skillLevelMap ID table.
Only canonical combat IDs are mapped; unknown/partial/conflicting maps are unresolved and never enumerated by Object.values.
talentLevelMapping provenance is copied into CalculationInput and support-member provenance.
Support combat state remains manual-boundary data and useUidBaseStats rejects stale UID final stats after manual level/weapon edits.
Unresolved talent mappings render an alert on the UID card and emit a warning-type message when applying the profile to calculation fields.

resolvedRequirements: each level is a positive finite number

manualBoundary.uidFinalStats: useUidBaseStats is valid only while UID-origin level/weapon/weapon-level fields still match; manual edits use resolver base stats.

openRisks: Actual UID numeric skill IDs still need an authoritative skillDepot/inherentProudSkill resolver fixture before they can be mapped semantically.
Unknown IDs intentionally produce safe level-1 provider values; raw levels remain available for a future resolver migration.
